sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.name: PlayStation Blog BR
sources.title: Agradecemos por tornarem Grand Theft Auto VI o maior lançamento da história PlayStation
sources.text: Uma homenagem à comunidade PlayStation e à Rockstar Games por proporcionarem um momento incrível para o universo dos games e do entretenimento. Após uma longa espera, os jogadores finalmente tiveram a chance de mergulhar em Grand Theft Auto VI . Foi incrível ver a comunidade PlayStation ao redor do mundo começar suas aventuras no estado de Leonida. Quer você tenha contado os dias para retornar às ruas de Vice City, ou esteja vivenciando a série Grand Theft Auto pela primeira vez, queremos aproveitar este momento para agradecer. A empolgação e a paixão da comunidade tornaram este um momento verdadeiramente especial para todos nós. O lançamento de GTAVI marca um momento extraordinário para os jogos e o entretenimento, tornando-se o maior lançamento de um jogo na história de PlayStation, ao longo de três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles. Mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos vivenciaram a história de Jason e Lucia em Grand Theft Auto VI para PlayStation 5. A comunidade PlayStation se uniu de forma expressiva para vivenciar Grand Theft Auto VI durante seu lançamento e fim de semana de estreia. Confira alguns destaques do período de lançamento, encerrado em 22 de novembro de 2026*: Estas são apenas algumas das maneiras pelas quais vimos nossa comunidade PlayStation se unir em torno deste momento incrível no mundo dos jogos, e estamos empolgados para ver como vocês continuarão criando e compartilhando novas memórias e experiências nos próximos meses. Por fim, gostaríamos de parabenizar nossos parceiros da Rockstar Games por trazerem este jogo extraordinário a jogadores de todo o mundo e por darem continuidade a uma parceria com a PlayStation que vem desde o Grand Theft Auto III, para PlayStation 2. Com GTAVI, trabalhamos para oferecer a melhor experiência no console PS5 e proporcionamos aos jogadores uma forma memorável de celebrar o título, por meio de dois controles sem fio DualSense de edição limitada, inspirados em Vice City. Também celebramos o lançamento com eventos ao vivo, incluindo o “Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival”, realizado em Miami no último fim de semana. E à nossa comunidade PlayStation, obrigado pela paixão e pelo apoio contínuos, e por escolherem vivenciar GTAVI no console PS5 . É o entusiasmo de vocês que torna momentos como este tão significativos para todos nós. Mal podemos esperar para ver aonde suas aventuras em Leonida levarão vocês! *Todos os números baseiam-se em dados internos da SIE coletados de 19 de novembro de 2026 a 22 de novembro de 2026.

stories.title: The Witcher 4 Will Have a Comparable Leap From GTA 5 to GTA 6, Says CD Projekt Red
stories.summary: CD Projekt Red expects a leap between The Witcher 3 and 4 that is comparable to the one between GTA 5 and 6.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: The Witcher 4 Will Have a Comparable Leap From GTA 5 to GTA 6, Says CD Projekt Red
sources.text: CD Projekt Red expects a leap between The Witcher 3 and 4 that is comparable to the one between GTA 5 and 6. In a recent earnings call (via Eurogamer ), CDPR was peppered with questions about GTA 6, since the developer also makes ambitious open-world games. CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski was asked whether or not the studio is looking at GTA for inspiration and if people can expect a similar leap between games. He noted that they have, indeed, observed the jump between GTA 5 and 6 before stating that fans can expect something comparable for The Witcher 4. "We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4 — I think so, yes," he said. "It's been 11 years, we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." The leap between GTA 5 and 6 is pretty absurd. There's a significant number of more things to do, particularly for those interested in roleplaying as a criminal. You can steal drugs, rob banks, knock over virtually any store on the map, and so much more. A lot of these details were either reserved for scripted missions in GTA 5 or were underbaked as open-world activities, but are fully fleshed out for you to do however you want in GTA 6. Advancements in NPCs, interactivity, immersion, and the ability to enter hundreds of interiors also make GTA 6 feel a world apart from its predecessor. Will The Witcher 4 also have tons of enterable interiors or deeper interactions with random NPCs? It's too soon to tell. It's possible that the leap for CD Projekt Red could come in a number of other ways, as The Witcher is a totally different world from GTA, after all. Maybe monster hunting will be more nuanced and involved than in The Witcher 3, similar to how GTA 6 has more engaging criminal activities. CDPR also noted that it plans to find ways to expand the game to more mainstream audiences, like GTA 6 has. GTA 6 collaborated with major mainstream artists to create original music, in addition to bold marketing campaigns that made the game difficult to ignore. The Witcher 4 is currently targeting a 2028 release , and we can probably expect more looks at the game next year. CDPR also noted that it has signed a marketing agreement with PlayStation for the game, which will also cover previous games and allow for opportunities with PlayStation Plus' services. Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

sources.title: The difference between The Witcher 3 and Witcher 4 will be 'comparable' to that of GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt boss says: 'I mean, it's been 11 years'
sources.text: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6. CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way. "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences. "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time. Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable: At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do." Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason. "You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero." Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments." "I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.' "They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that." Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.) seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed The Witcher 4 is currently slated for launch sometime in 2028, while Cyberpunk 2 isn't expected out before 2030. sources.title: GTA 6 just got a patch that fixed a progression bug on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S
sources.text: Rockstar just issued a new patch for GTA 6 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, targeting a few issues players have been reporting since the game launched last Thursday (19th November). The 23rd November patch for the game deploys seven major fixes for the game, including a pretty significant bug that prevented phone calls not triggering at certain points, resulting in a scenario where you could be locked out of progressing the game. The official update is titled 'version 01.002.002', and its weighs in at different sizes on different consoles: it's 603.8 MB on PS5, and 1.6 GB on Xbox Series X/S. Thanks to an update on the Rockstar website , you can read all of the updates that arrive with the latest pathc below. There have been a few fairly high-profile cases of the autosave not working as the developer intended, leading to a few cases of streamers losing plenty of real-world time thanks to unpredictable auto-save behaviour. JasonTheWeen lost 12 hours of progress on the PS5 , for example. But there's one issue here the developer hasn't addressed: vignetting. Plenty of players have taken to online communities to complain about the vignette effect that pops into the game - theoretically to help with motion smoothing and various grapihcal elements as the game runs in 30FPS. THe effect is worsened when you're fatigued, hungry, or have some other status effect, but it is present quite a lot of the time, too. Most of the responses to a tweet about the patch posted by the Rockstar Support account reference the vignetting in GTA 6, and the developer has issued no response at the time of writing.

sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: GTA 6 has more framerate drops on PS5 than Xbox Series X, according to analysis
sources.text: It looks like Xbox Series X can maintain 30fps more reliably than PS5 Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay analysis shows that Xbox Series X can maintain 30fps more reliably than the base PS5. This comes from tests conducted by Digital Foundry, which has compared the performance on the base PS5 directly with Xbox Series X. While finding that the consoles support the same resolution, it was noted that Xbox experiences fewer framerate dips, and even supports higher-quality visuals in some scenes. “Like in most other current-gen games, Series X and PS5 look about the same. Key visual settings are matched here,” says Digital Foundry. “In typical play, both of them hit 30 FPS or don’t fall far below, but I think GTA 6 is balanced on a knife’s edge here in performance terms, and the game can dip below 30 FPS more often than I’d like. “PS5 seems substantially worse off in this respect,” the analysis continues. “I managed to roughly match a few sequences, and PS5 likes to drop frames more often than Series X in spots that seem to cause issues for this game, like in fast vehicle traversal.” Digital Foundry argues this is because the visuals are matched, for the most part, across platforms, which hurts PS5 because the Series X is better equipped to handle this level of detail. However, another point in Xbox’s favour is that there are “minor resolution differences that favour Series X” in some parts of the game. Despite this, both versions do experience performance dips, so the Series X is not immune to framerate drops. While stressing that these differences are minor, it comes after Rockstar heavily promoted the PS5 version of the game over the Xbox Series X/S release. This is because Rockstar signed a marketing agreement with Sony , allowing it to say that its console was the best way to experience GTA 6. This agreement also saw Rockstar promote features that were unique to the PS5 version of GTA 6 . These are mostly found in the PS5’s DualSense controller, with haptic feedback used heavily throughout GTA 6. Itâs worth noting that Sonyâs more powerful PS5 Pro console is judged to provide the best experience for GTA 6, due to its 4K-like image quality and ray-traced shadows.

sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.title: GTA 6 Runs Better On Xbox Series X Than Base PS5
sources.text: GTA 6 is smashing records left and right, but a hot topic of discussion since the game launched last week is performance. Targeting 30 frames per second was already negative news for many console owners, and it turns out platform choice matters quite a bit in this case. In a feature on Digital Foundry , the outlet best known for video game performance discussion, it’s been found that GTA 6 performs better on Xbox Series X, at least compared to a base PS5 system. While the PS5 Pro seems to be the overall benchmark, it’s also not the most popular way to play on PlayStation. You can purchase Grand Theft Auto 6 here to test everything out yourself. Digital Foundry runs extensive testing on many video games and their performance. Today, the site revealed its findings when comparing GTA 6 across compatible consoles in the PlayStation and Xbox families. Personally, I’ve been playing GTA 6 on a base PS5, and though it’s been confirmed the game is targeting 30 frames per second across all platforms, I’ve noticed drops on my end in several places. Nothing has been game-breaking, but I have been curious if base PS5 is really the place to be. Turns out, the experience seems to be better overall on the Xbox Series X, Microsoft’s current flagship console. Digital Foundry claims that “ Xbox Series X provides a virtually identical visual presentation to the PS5 .” The only notable difference in visuals between the base PS5 and the Series X is more heat haze on the Xbox, but that was deemed negligible to the experience overall. The main difference between the two consoles is how well they match the targeted 30 FPS, and it seems Xbox Series X is more stable in this regard. Digital Foundry says the base PS5 has “substantially more” frame drops into the 20s during more crowded sections of the game compared to the Series X. This is said to partially be due to the fact that the Series X features 120Hz VRR, while neither PS5 consoles have the same. While exact figures in sales between base PS5 and the PS5 Pro aren’t confirmed, what is known is that significantly more PlayStation gamers play on the base unit. While GTA 6 broke several launch day records on the PlayStation ecosystem, turns out, this also means many millions of players are having a worse experience than those on both Xbox Series X and PS5 Pro. The highest-performing console for GTA 6 overall, however, is the PS5 Pro. While it’s still more of a “niche” console in terms of market share than the base unit, anyone who’s made the jump to Pro is reaping the benefits with GTA 6. Digital Foundry reports that the PS5 Pro is the best console overall for the smoothest, most stable framerate. The Pro stays closer to 30 FPS much more consistently, and while dips are still possible and likely, it’s not as prevalent an issue overall. Any frame drops on PS5 Pro are also typically more short-lived than on any other console. Overall, it seems the console performance rankings for GTA 6 are as follows: Xbox Series S seems to have the worst results with frame rates, and also features a bug where audio will sporadically cut out entirely. With the majority of GTA 6 players more than likely currently playing on a base PS5 compared to anything else, at least it’s not the lowest-rated console overall. Still, it seems Xbox Series X owners have a reason to champion their console in this case compared to the majority. How has your experience been playing GTA 6 on console so far? sources.title: God of War Laufey's Faye actor jumps from games to live-action, as Amazon casts Deborah Ann Woll in upcoming series
sources.text: After appearing in both God of War Ragnarok and next year's God of War Laufey, Deborah Ann Woll is about to reprise her role as Faye in Amazon Prime Video's upcoming live-action series. Variety reports that the God of War cast list is now welcoming a second actor pulled straight from Sony Santa Monica's video game series. Deborah Ann Woll first showed up in the games as Kratos' wife and Atreus' mother during God of War Ragnarok, but she's also about to enter the spotlight proper in God of War Laufey. Amazon's God of War cast now includes Dave Bautista (Guardians of the Galaxy) as god killer Kratos, Callum Vinson (Chucky) as Atreus, Mandy Patinkin as Odin and Ólafur Darri Ólafsson as Thor. Alastair Duncan is also making the game-to-show jump by stepping back into the figurative shoes of chatty head Mimir. Earlier in the year, the God of War show halted production when former Kratos actor Ryan Hurst suffered an on-set injury. Bautista soon took over the role and production began again in October - all of Hurst's scenes had to be reshot, of course. There's no release date yet for the show, but it's said to follow the Norse era of the games which began in 2018's more serious and stern revamp. Amazon ordered a two-season run for the show, which apparently means both seasons will be filmed back-to-back. Meanwhile, God of War Laufey was recently delayed from February 2027 to May 2027, giving the PS5 exclusive slightly more breathing room away from Fable, Persona 4 Revival and Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. "We will make the most of each moment until then by putting in the finishing touches and pushing the game to its fullest potential," developer Sony Santa Monica said at the time. "On behalf of everyone on the team, we appreciate your patience and we'll be back to share more updates soon." While the game puts Faye in the leading role as she battles with gods in a multi-mythological afterlife, the studio was quick to note that her journey isn't considered a side game. God of War Laufey will still connect to future games in the series and, yep, Kratos will eventually be back , too. "Genuinely, I thought I was going to be much more offended by it, but one, I'm not on social media, so that helps, and two, I don't know, I feel totally unbothered," Woll said of the online trolls who were targeting Laufey after its reveal this summer. "Because I just know it's great. It's okay if it's not your cup of tea, but in no universe is it bad."

sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 finalmente chegou ao PS5 e Xbox Series X|S na última quinta-feira (19), reunindo milhões de jogadores ao redor do mundo. Além da grande procura pelo novo jogo da Rockstar, a sequência também conquistou uma recepção positiva no Metacritic, tornando-se o único título do século XXI a alcançar média de 99 pontos no agregador . Agora, a Sony confirmou mais um marco para a aventura de Jason e Lucia: GTA 6 se tornou o maior lançamento da história da PlayStation . Segundo a empresa, mais de 39 milhões de jogadores já aproveitaram o game no PS5 desde a estreia. Os números foram divulgados em uma publicação no blog oficial da PlayStation , que também revelou recordes de horas jogadas e consoles conectados durante o período de lançamento. A marca certamente reforça o desempenho comercial do título, que já havia estabelecido recordes de vendas logo no primeiro dia. Segundo a Sony, mais de 39 milhões de jogadores únicos experimentaram GTA 6 no PS5 desde o lançamento. A empresa classificou o resultado como “o maior lançamento da história do PlayStation”, considerando as três décadas e cinco gerações de consoles da marca. Os dados divulgados pela companhia consideram o período entre a estreia, em 19 de novembro, e o dia 22. Nesse intervalo, os jogadores acumularam 683 milhões de horas de gameplay no console, com uma média de 17,4 horas explorando o estado de Leonida por pessoa. A Sony também confirmou que GTA 6 estabeleceu um novo recorde de jogadores simultâneos em um único jogo na história do PlayStation. A marca superou os números anteriores de títulos multiplayer, gratuitos e até mesmo experiências para um jogador. Outro dado destacado pela empresa foi o número de consoles conectados. Durante o período de lançamento, a PlayStation registrou seu maior volume de PS5 online em um único dia desde a chegada do console, desconsiderando o período de festas de fim de ano. Além disso, GTA 6 foi o primeiro jogo executado em 70% dos novos PS5 conectados entre a estreia e 22 de novembro. O desempenho também acompanha os números divulgados anteriormente pela Rockstar e pela Take-Two . As empresas afirmaram na última sexta (20) que GTA 6 vendeu mais de 32 milhões de cópias em pré-venda e arrecadou US$ 3,79 bilhões no primeiro dia. De acordo com a publisher, o resultado representa um novo recorde de estreia para um produto de entretenimento em qualquer mídia. A empresa também destacou a recepção da crítica, com o jogo alcançando “aclamação universal” e respeitáveis 99 pontos de média no Metacritic. Para se ter noção do feito, GTA 5 arrecadou US$ 1 bilhão nos primeiros três dias de disponibilidade quando foi lançado em 2013. Já Vingadores: Ultimato , um dos maiores sucessos do cinema, levou cinco dias para atingir a mesma marca mundialmente. A Sony aproveitou a publicação para agradecer aos jogadores e parabenizar a Rockstar pelo resultado. “Obrigado por fazer parte deste momento”, declarou a empresa, que também destacou a parceria entre as duas companhias — iniciada ainda na época de GTA 3 no PlayStation 2. sources.title: GTA 6 was the "biggest launch in PlayStation history", with the highest number of concurrent players ever
sources.text: Release day saw a spike in newly connected PS5 consoles, although falling short of year-end highs Christmas did not come early for Sony, but it came close: the firm has declared that GTA 6 was the largest game launch in the platform's history, driving a record number of concurrent players on its November 19th launch, although the number of new consoles playing the game fell short of year-end highs. A post on the PlayStation Blog said the game has attracted more than 39 million unique players since launch, who have cumulatively logged 683 million hours of gameplay. The average total playtime was 17.4 hours, the firm said. The GTA 6 launch day saw a strong but not unprecedented spike in new console usage, which Sony described as the largest number of connected consoles in a single day aside from the console launch and end-of-year holidays. GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PlayStation consoles. Xbox has made no public statements as to the game's success on its platform. Data from Ampere Analysis suggested strong initial performance due to the relative ease with which users could set their location to New Zealand and start playing early, with over two million players getting early access on the platform . Subsequent data from Circana indicated that over 56% of global Xbox players had engaged with the game on launch day. Rockstar previously announced that pre-orders for the game totalled 32.5 million units, achieving $3.79 billion in retail sales revenue on its first day , a new record for an entertainment release.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Sony: GTA 6 set record for 'highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation' ever
sources.text: The industry is finding new milestones to measure GTA 6's success. GTA 6 has been shattering records since before it came out, becoming the top-rated game in the history of Metacritic before it had the biggest entertainment launch (by dollars) in history. Sony is now joining in that victory lap by sharing GTA 6 milestones as they pertain to PlayStation. "More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5," Sony content communications manager Tim Turi wrote in a blog post today. That is a staggering number, especially considering GTA 6 also launched on Xbox and will (eventually) hit PC . But that's not a sales record—Rockstar still has a ways to go to surpass GTA 5's 230 million lifetime sales . What is unprecedented, at least for PlayStation, is GTA 6's concurrents over launch weekend. "GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles," Turi said. That's the wild one to me, because that means more people were playing GTA 6 at the same time on the largest console platform than Call of Duty, GTA 5 , or even Fortnite has ever achieved. Turi didn't share the concurrent figure itself, which is too bad—Steam remains the only platform that hands out exact player data. If the figure is theoretically higher than some of the biggest concurrent peaks we know about on Steam, then it could've been as high as 3-4 million players. On average, those 39 million PS5 players logged 17.4 hours over four days. Let's just say my hour count represents the higher end of that average, and I'm still less than halfway through the main story. sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Rockstar has "been an awesome partner" for the Max Payne 1 and 2 remakes, says Remedy CEO
sources.text: The companies are old friends in the industry Remakes of the first two Max Payne games are on the way, and Rockstar 's been helping Remedy get the releases in order. According to the Control and Alan Wake studio, collaborating with the purveyor of GTA 6 has been absolutely grand so far. Jean-Charles Gaudechon, the CEO of Remedy, described the working relationship between the two outfits in glowing terms for Game File . "Honestly, it's been great," he says. "You know why? Because I think they're super respectful of Remedy." Respect is a good start to any collaboration. Gaudechon then doubles down, just to make it clear everything's positive right now. "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner," he adds. "And it's no bullshit." Well, it seems he doesn't have any complaints, anyway. Remedy and Rockstar actually have quite a bit of history, since the studio that gave us GTA actually worked on ports of the first Max Payne, then published the second outright. It only makes sense, then, that they'd team back up to give both games a lick of paint and update them for modern hardware. As you may well be aware, it's been a while since Rockstar's done anything outside of the Grand Theft Auto or Red Dead Redemption mines. Time was the developer and publisher would be involved in all sorts of projects, but nowadays the focus tends to be a little more streamlined. I guess that's what happens when you make the biggest games in the industry. The two have been working on these do-overs since around 2022, and we don't have a release window yet. Perhaps now that Alan Wake 2 and Control: Resonant are out of the way, Remedy can put in more resource, while Rockstar can finally do something that isn't GTA 6. I mean, how much is there to do post-launch for such a game? Our boy Max is waiting, people – come on. sources.title: Remedy CEO praises Rockstar's support for the Max Payne 1 & 2 remake and respecting Remedy's creative vision
sources.text: "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner." Alan Wake and Control studio Remedy Entertainment is currently developing a highly-anticipated Max Payne 1 & 2 remake. The Finnish studio is doing so in partnership with Grand Theft Auto 6 studio Rockstar, which owns the IP and is funding the remake's development. So how has that relationship been? According to Remedy CEO Jean-Charles Gaudechon, working with Rockstar has been "amazing". "Honestly, it's been great," Gaudechon told Game File . "You know why? Because I think they're super respectful of Remedy." Gaudechon is so positive on Remedy's working relationship with Rockstar that he emphasised his praise for Rockstar further. "I'll say it out loud: They've honestly been an awesome partner. And it's no bullshit," he added. The original Max Payne was released in 2001, and its sequel in 2003 - both developed by Remedy. Rockstar published the second game and worked on the original's console ports. Rockstar developed a third entry in the series, Max Payne 3 , which Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser recently called something of a failure . "Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success," said Houser. The Max Payne 1 & 2 remake has been in the works since 2022 , but only entered full production in 2024 . The game is understood to be Remedy's current project, though the studio also has another unannounced project in the works. In other Remedy news, the studio recently posted one of its best financial quarters , off the back of the release of Control Resonant, the studio's fastest-selling game ever .

sources.title: How to get the GTA 6 BF Bandito
sources.text: You won't find the BF Bandito in a lock up in GTA 6, as this vehicle heist is a little tricker to pull off While you're out stealing cars for Moses, the GTA 6 BF Bandito will appear on your list, taking you out to the very rural roads of South Leonard County and the Buckskin Swamp. This GTA 6 heist is slightly harder than the others you might have carried out so far though, as this car will be on the move. Like all of Moses' targets, the rough location of the BF Bandito is marked on the map, but as you make your way there, you'll pass by some whoopin' and hollerin' country dwellers who are already taking the buggy for a spin. Here's how to get your hands on the GTA 6 Bandito and get paid. The map marker will take you to the rough location of the BF Bandito, where you should keep your eyes and ears open for some locals riding around the swamps on buggies - one of these is the Bandito. To claim it for yourself, you'll need to stop the Bandito driver, and there are a few ways to do this. If you clock him fast enough, particularly when crossing water, you can simply get in front of him, and he'll stop. Otherwise, you can chase down the Bandito, shooting the driver and his pals. Weirdly, though, when I did this challenge, the driver eventually just stopped and bolted, leaving the buggy free for me to take, though I'm not sure exactly what triggered him to do this. Essentially, just stay close, don't destroy the car by shooting it too much, and it'll be yours in no time. sources.title: How to get your car out of the impound in GTA 6
sources.text: There's the easy way and the expensive way There's the easy way and the expensive way It doesn't take long for one of your cars to end up at the police impound in Grand Theft Auto 6 . You might have abandoned it near a crime scene, or they arrested you while you were driving it. While the circumstances may vary, you have only two ways to proceed if a car is impounded: you forget about it or you retrieve it. If you are not ready to abandon your favorite car and want it back, we've got you covered. Here's how to get your car out of the impound in GTA 6 . There are two methods to retrieve a car from the police impound: you can either steal it back or pay for it . Both are valid, but the second one becomes available only in Chapter 2. Stealing the car is the most plausible and cheapest option to execute. You just need to head to the impound lot, enter, and drive your car away from there. Some impounds, like the one in Port Gellhorn, have openings that you can use to enter unnoticed. Regardless of how you get inside, the challenge is escaping from the police once you leave. You must be prepared to run away, so try to come up with an escape route by setting a destination far from the city. Now, the second option requires the Scooter Bros app , which you unlock in Chapter 2 after completing Moses' mission. If you have it already, open the app and select the impounded car (the one with a police badge icon). You will see that the first option in the menu is to pay a fee to retrieve the car . The price varies depending on how far you are from the police impound . For example, I would have to pay $699 to get my car back from the Port Gellhorn impound while in Vice City. However, if you have upgraded your Scooter Bros account to Premium , you can use your remaining daily credits to request an impounded vehicle. Since this will essentially consume all your credits for the day, you should wait until you have only one left before using this option. sources.title: How to flip your car in GTA 6
sources.text: Flipping your car in Grand Theft Auto 6 works a bit differently than it did in previous games. In Rockstar's bid for realism, the team made it so you can't flip your car while you're still in it. Instead, whichever character you're controlling will have to get out of the car and turn it over. Note that flipping only works on certain vehicles, though. You can flip cars, boats, even larger construction vehicles, but not planes. Below, we explain how to flip your car in GTA 6 . If you manage to turn over your sedan, ATV, boat, or cement truck, and you do it without getting wasted ( GTA 6 's term for "destroying it completely and dying"), you might think you'll have to get Scooter Bros to deliver the vehicle for you. Well, you don't. Keep that hard-stolen cash in your BuckMe account and fix it yourself. GTA 6 never teaches you how to flip your car back over, though, and it's not mentioned in any of the control layout options. Here's what you have to do: And you're good to go on your merry way. That said, there are a few caveats to bear in mind if you're trying to flip your car. Try to push the car from the middle. If you're at either end of it, we noticed the prompt tends not to appear. Also, if there's an obstacle on the other side of the car, like a thick hedge or a wall, you won't be able to flip it. The same is true for when your car is just stuck on something, like a guardrail. The game won't let you flip it off the offending object, as it has to be completely upended for the "shove" prompt to appear. stories.title: Should You Trust Halifax in GTA 6?
stories.summary: Should you trust Halifax in GTA 6's chapter three mission, Dubious Provenance? We have the answer.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Should You Trust Halifax in GTA 6?
sources.text: Warning: Spoilers for the Dubious Provenance mission in chapter three of GTA 6 follow. GTA 6 is full of choices, big and small. In fact, the whole way you choose to play the game is a choice, whether that be as an ultraviolet psychopath or a more professional class of criminal. Or if you decide that Jason and Lucia are a couple hopelessly head-over-heels in love, or more platonic partners in crime. Some choices, however, are much more binary, with instant effects tied to them. One of the clearest examples of this is presented to you during a chapter three mission called Dubious Provenance. Should you trust Halifax or not? The answer is twofold: the smart decision is to reject his offer, but the much more fun option is to place your faith in him. Let me explain. Dubious Provenance kicks off by driving all the way to the fancy town of Capri, found in the east of Leonida, and home to the sort of houses Jason and Lucia can only dream of living in at this point in their story. Just by the centre of town is an antiques store where you’re tasked with bringing the mysterious statue that has fallen into your possession to be valued. Halifax, a man with a fairly convincing British accent, overhears your conversation with the shop’s owner, Evelyn, and offers you a deal. While she isn’t interested in the statue, he most definitely is, telling you that he will get it valued for you if you hand it over. Now, despite his smart appearance, all is not what it seems with Halifax, and without spoiling it too much, he’s not exactly the antiques expert he claims to be. The smart, and arguably correct, choice from a story perspective is to reject him. But the much more fun and beneficial option (if you’re a collectibles hunter) is to accept. Accepting adds a couple more main missions to the Dubious Provenance story rather than just ending it there and then. You’ll also receive the Crowex Octane “Bobby Ambrose” unique watch in return. This is a missable collectible otherwise. But more importantly, you get two more very fun missions to play through. The first includes a stealthy infiltration and a massive, and I mean, massive revelation about Halifax. The second is one of the best chase sequences in GTA 6, scored hilariously to a great bit of contrapuntal music. For full spoilers and a step-by-step guide, you can check out our walkthrough . If you reject, you won’t get the watch, but you will have a second shot at playing through these missions. Halifax will later contact you and give you the option to phone him if you change your mind, transforming these main missions into optional ones. These must be completed by the end of chapter three , or they’ll disappear forever, though. Ultimately, the choice to accept or reject comes down to whether you want the watch or not. Of course, you can choose to just never contact him again if you’re desperate to progress through the story as quickly as possible, but you will miss out on a great bit of fun as a result. So, should you trust Halifax during Dubious Provenance? I’d say yes; it’s a much more fun road to take if you’re looking to squeeze every bit of enjoyment out of GTA 6. Plus, who could ever resist a moustache like that? sources.title: Should You Participate in the Safe Word Mission in GTA 6?
sources.text: What happens if you participate in Safe Word in GTA 6 Wondering if you should participate in the Safe Word mission in GTA 6? During the Safe Word mission in GTA 6, players face an awkward decision while Jason is visiting Gil’s mansion.Â But should you participate, or is it better to refuse? In this guide, we’ll explain what happens with each choice. This is one of many GTA 6 guides we’ve published this week. Check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub . Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. Although the decision might seem relatively minor, it affects the interaction between Jason and Lucia during the mission. Choosing not to participate allows Jason to maintain his loyalty to Lucia while continuing with the mission. However, participating offers an alternative interaction during the poolside scene. Importantly, refusing does not prevent you from completing Safe Word not does it affect which rewards you get from Safe Word. If you agree to participate, Jason goes along with the request during the poolside scene. This creates an additional interaction before the mission continues as it does if you don’t participate. You will take a hit to Jason and Lucia’s relationship. It’s not a major hit, but Lucia will comment on your actions in this mission for several missions afterwards. However, players who want to keep Jason and Lucia’s relationship on good terms may prefer to avoid this option. He will request to go to the bathroom, and the scene will end, allowing him to progress to the next stage of the mission, infiltrating the mansion and stealing the safe.
